module_outcomes: Nokuqonda isakhiwo se-athomu, ulumbano ngokwamakhemikhali olwenzeka phakathi kwama-athomu kanye nezinhlobo zolumbanokhemikhali ezenzekayo.

Nolwazi lokubhala amafomula amakhemikhali, ukulinganisa izibalokulinganisa, kanye nokusebenzisa amakhonsepthi enaninhlayiya eqoqweni ezibalweni zamakhemikhali kulumbanokhemikhali lobungakosisindo kanye nolumbanokhemikhali kwingxubekuncibilika.
Nokuqonda ukuhlelwa kwemetha kanye nezingxenye zesisekelo semetha ezigabeni eziqinile, eziwuketshezi kanye neziyigesi kanye nezingxenye zengxubekuncibilika.

Ukuqonda okuphelele kwemithetho eyisisekelo soguqukomakhemikhali ngokushisa, isimokulingana samakhemikhali, ichemistry kagesi kanye nomumo wama- esidi, ama-base kanye nosawoti, kanye nokusebenzisa lolo lwazi uma kwenziwa ama-acid base titration.
Ukukwazi ukukhombisa amakhono ahlukene nalula elabhorethri, okuhlanganisa ukulinganisa kanye nokulinganisa
module_purpose: Inhloso yale mojuli ukunikeza abafundi isisekelo esidingekayo ku- chemistry uma beqhubeka nezifundo ze-chemistry ehlaziyayo, engenakhabhoni, enekhabhoni kanye nephysical chemistry.
